Subject (in full) Report on possibility of trouble in Shanghai by local communists
on November 16.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by （签名）

With reference to the attached cutting from the
Shanghai Times of November 6, 1931 concerning a report that local
Chinese communists are planning to create disorders in Shanghai
on November 16, careful enquiries made by the staff of this office
fail to reveal any intimation of possible disturbances which may
likely take place in Shanghai on November 16.

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, FRIDAY NOVEMBER 6, 1931
Communists Planning
Local Disturbances
NANKING, Nov. 5.—The
Government authorities have
received a report that the
Chinese Communist leaders
are holding a National Com-
munist Congress in Kiangsi.
It is stated that they are
planning to stage serious
disturbances in Shanghai on
November 10.
The Government has issued
instructions to the Shanghai
authorities to make the
necessary preparations to
guard against any distur-
bance.—Reuter.
